notes.title: New PLAYISM Title: Giraffe and Annika Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear PLAYISM fans,

We are writing to inform you that today marks the release of our newest title.

Heartfelt 3D Action+Rhythm Action game, Giraffe and Annika.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122100/Giraffe__Annika/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r2PcSX7iinw

Set on Spica Island, enjoy the sights and sounds as you embark on a journey packed with 3D platforming action, adventure, and rhythm game boss fights!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/ea5cafad264aac0053fa8150484c26945a023871.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/311fa9b4c2a07e69510dbd7835c3e014fd0335a9.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/44215ecb8f1da94cfd33ee8e8323561db2b65a6f.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/a155b8b4391c3107f29bbf4588b444a20f1eabeb.jpg

Soundtrack also available!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1241210/Giraffe_and_Annika_Original_Sound_Track/

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Version Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hi All! 

Due to various issues related to the text getting garbled, it took a really long time to solve the issue. 

The Simplified Chinese version of LiEat is finally in its very final stages, with all the acheivements unlocking properly! 
We are planning to to release LiEat's Simplified Chinese version ver soon, and we hope that you are all looking forward to it.

notes.title: LiEat Update - 3.4.2017
notes.notes:
Hi All

We have just updated LiEat with the following:

Portuguese version: fixed the issue with certain achievements not unlocking properly

Thank you for your patience, and we hope that you continue enjoying the game!

notes.title: LiEat Update - Soundtrack
notes.notes:
Last week I told you to wait for an announcement. 

And a few of you have spotted me on the forums hinting at it... 

But now we can finally announce that the Soundtrack has been added to LiEat, for FREE! 

So when you get an update to your game, make sure to check your local files for the soundtrack for the whole game. 

We hope you enjoy it!!

notes.title: LiEat gets a release date!!
notes.notes:
Are you ready?

LiEat will be releasing on 26th February. 

This amazing trilogy will be available for only $2.99. Travel with Efina to discover the value of truth and the consequence of lies. 

Who is excited?
